winning_hook_formulas: The 'Counter-Intuitive Warning' Formula: [Warning Emoji] + [Common Financial Habit] + [The Hidden Danger/Trap]

script_directives: Keep total duration under 22 seconds to force high repeat-view rates.
Eliminate fluff intros; start the hook within the first 0.5 seconds of the video.
Use high-contrast visual callouts for numbers and percentages to anchor viewer attention.
seo_directives: Use specific, searchable financial keywords in the title (e.g., Nifty, FD, Stocks) rather than generic clickbait.
Limit hashtags to 3-4 highly relevant tags (e.g., #StockMarketIndia, #PersonalFinance, #Investing) to avoid algorithm confusion.
